items.title: What Brain Fog Really Feels Like
items.summary: Dr. David Musnick explains the slow thinking, low mental energy, word-finding trouble, poor focus, and memory slips people often mean when they describe brain fog.
body: Brain fog is a description of impaired cognitive function, not a diagnosis. Dr. Musnick outlines common signs people notice and explains why persistent or worsening symptoms deserve a careful evaluation.
This excerpt comes from Brain Fog, Part 1 and is provided for general education. It does not replace individualized medical evaluation or treatment.

items.title: Brain Fog: Testing and Foundational Support
items.summary: Dr. David Musnick discusses tests that may be considered for persistent brain fog and the foundational steps he uses while investigating possible causes.
body: This excerpt covers selected laboratory and exposure questions that may be considered during an evaluation for persistent brain fog, along with basic brain-supportive habits used while the underlying cause is investigated.
Testing and treatment choices depend on a person's history, examination, and risk factors. This clip is educational and does not recommend a specific test or treatment for every viewer.

items.title: Cilantro-Basil Pesto with Broccoli Sprouts
items.summary: Dr. David Musnick demonstrates a dairy-free pesto with cilantro, basil, broccoli sprouts, olive oil, pistachios, and simple seasonings, then explains why he chooses those ingredients.
body: Dr. Musnick combines fresh herbs, broccoli sprouts, olive oil, nuts, and seasonings into a dairy-free pesto. He also discusses the ingredients he chooses and practical ways to use the finished pesto with vegetables, eggs, fish, or meat.
Ingredient amounts are demonstrated in the video rather than presented as a standardized medical nutrition plan. Adjust ingredients for allergies, dietary needs, and clinician guidance.
